rag.content:
lemma linesInPlane_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols) (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) :
    ConstAbsProp (S.val (0 : Fin 4), S.val (1 : Fin 4)) := by
  simp only [ConstAbsProp, Fin.isValue]
  by_contra hn
  have hLin := pureU1_linear S.1.1
  have hcube := pureU1_cube S
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, PureU1_numberCharges] at hLin hcube
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hLin hcube
  rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at hn
  simp only [Fin.isValue, not_or] at hn
  have l012 := hS 0 1 2 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l013 := hS 0 1 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l023 := hS 0 2 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  simp_all [LineInPlaneProp]
  have h1 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
    linear_combination l012 / 2 + -1 * l013 / 2
  by_cases h2 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = S.val (2 : Fin 4)
  · simp_all
    have h3 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
      linear_combination l012 + 3 * h1
    rw [← h1, h3] at hcube
    have h4 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
    simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h4
    simp_all only [neg_mul, neg_neg, add_left_eq_self, add_right_eq_self, not_true_eq_false,
      false_and]
  · by_cases h3 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4)
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l012 + h1
      simp_all
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l023
      have h5 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l013 - 1 * h4
      rw [h4, h5] at hcube
      have h6 : S.val (3 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
        linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h6
      simp_all

informal_statement: Let \( S \) be a solution in the linear solutions space of the cubic permutation defined by \( 2n + 3 \) (where \( n \) is a non-negative integer). Given that \( S \) satisfies the boundary value property \( \text{ConstAbs} \) and belongs to the class \( \text{lineInCubicPerm} \), we conclude that \( S \) must be identically zero.
informal_proof: To establish that \( S = 0 \), we begin by recognizing that \( S \) resides in the linear solutions of a cubic permutation characterized by \( 2n + 3 \). The application of \( \text{ConstAbs} \) ensures that \( S \) adheres to specific boundary conditions that impose its uniqueness. Furthermore, since \( S \) is an element of \( \text{lineInCubicPerm} \), its behavior under these constraints is meticulously controlled. By invoking the properties of \( \text{ConstAbs} \) and \( \text{lineInCubicPerm} \), we deduce that the only solution compatible with these conditions is the trivial solution \( S = 0 \).

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_cond {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ+1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInPlaneProp ((S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)), ((S.val (oddShiftFst 0)), (S.val oddShiftZero))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, f, hfg⟩ := span_basis S
  have h1 := lineInCubicPerm_swap LIC 0 g f hfg
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube' g f hfg] at h1
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
  · left
    linear_combination h1
  · cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
      linear_combination h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
      linear_combination h1

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInPlaneCond S := by
  refine @Prop_three (2 * n.succ.succ + 1) LineInPlaneProp S (oddShiftSnd 0) (oddShiftFst 0)
    oddShiftZero ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact fun M => lineInCubicPerm_last_cond (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC M)

lemma lineInCubicPerm_constAbs {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : ConstAbs S.val :=
  linesInPlane_constAbs (lineInCubicPerm_last_perm LIC)

theorem lineInCubicPerm_zero {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : S = 0 := by exact?

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h

  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

rag.name: PureU1.linesInPlane_four
rag.content:
lemma linesInPlane_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols) (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) :
    ConstAbsProp (S.val (0 : Fin 4), S.val (1 : Fin 4)) := by
  simp only [ConstAbsProp, Fin.isValue]
  by_contra hn
  have hLin := pureU1_linear S.1.1
  have hcube := pureU1_cube S
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, PureU1_numberCharges] at hLin hcube
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hLin hcube
  rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at hn
  simp only [Fin.isValue, not_or] at hn
  have l012 := hS 0 1 2 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l013 := hS 0 1 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l023 := hS 0 2 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  simp_all [LineInPlaneProp]
  have h1 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
    linear_combination l012 / 2 + -1 * l013 / 2
  by_cases h2 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = S.val (2 : Fin 4)
  · simp_all
    have h3 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
      linear_combination l012 + 3 * h1
    rw [← h1, h3] at hcube
    have h4 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
    simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h4
    simp_all only [neg_mul, neg_neg, add_left_eq_self, add_right_eq_self, not_true_eq_false,
      false_and]
  · by_cases h3 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4)
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l012 + h1
      simp_all
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l023
      have h5 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l013 - 1 * h4
      rw [h4, h5] at hcube
      have h6 : S.val (3 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
        linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h6
      simp_all

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_cond {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ+1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInPlaneProp ((S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)), ((S.val (oddShiftFst 0)), (S.val oddShiftZero))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, f, hfg⟩ := span_basis S
  have h1 := lineInCubicPerm_swap LIC 0 g f hfg
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube' g f hfg] at h1
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
  · left
    linear_combination h1
  · cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
      linear_combination h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
      linear_combination h1

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInPlaneCond S := by
  refine @Prop_three (2 * n.succ.succ + 1) LineInPlaneProp S (oddShiftSnd 0) (oddShiftFst 0)
    oddShiftZero ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact fun M => lineInCubicPerm_last_cond (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC M)

lemma lineInCubicPerm_constAbs {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : ConstAbs S.val := by exact?

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}

      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h

  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

lemma lineInPlaneCond_eq_last' {S : (PureU1 (n.succ.succ)).LinSols} (hS : LineInPlaneCond S)
    (h : ¬ (S.val ((Fin.last n).castSucc))^2 = (S.val ((Fin.last n).succ))^2) :
    (2 - n) * S.val (Fin.last (n + 1)) =
    - (2 - n)* S.val (Fin.castSucc (Fin.last n)) := by
  erw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at h
  rw [LineInPlaneCond] at hS
  simp only [LineInPlaneProp] at hS
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_last, not_or] at h
  have h1 (i : Fin n) : S.val i.castSucc.castSucc =
      - (S.val ((Fin.last n).castSucc) + (S.val ((Fin.last n).succ))) / 2 := by
    have h1S := hS (Fin.last n).castSucc ((Fin.last n).succ) i.castSucc.castSucc
      (by simp only [Fin.ext_iff, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_last, ne_eq]
          exact Nat.ne_add_one ↑(Fin.last n).castSucc)
      (by simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_last, ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last,
        Fin.coe_castSucc]
          omega)
      (by simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
          omega)
    simp_all only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ne_eq, Fin.succ_last, false_or, neg_add_rev]
    field_simp
    linear_combination h1S
  have h2 := pureU1_last S
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc] at h2
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, h1, Fin.succ_last, neg_add_rev, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at h2
  field_simp at h2
  linear_combination h2

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

lemma linesInPlane_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols) (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) :
    ConstAbsProp (S.val (0 : Fin 4), S.val (1 : Fin 4)) := by
  simp only [ConstAbsProp, Fin.isValue]
  by_contra hn
  have hLin := pureU1_linear S.1.1
  have hcube := pureU1_cube S
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, PureU1_numberCharges] at hLin hcube
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hLin hcube
  rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at hn
  simp only [Fin.isValue, not_or] at hn
  have l012 := hS 0 1 2 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l013 := hS 0 1 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l023 := hS 0 2 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  simp_all [LineInPlaneProp]
  have h1 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
    linear_combination l012 / 2 + -1 * l013 / 2
  by_cases h2 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = S.val (2 : Fin 4)
  · simp_all
    have h3 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
      linear_combination l012 + 3 * h1
    rw [← h1, h3] at hcube
    have h4 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
    simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h4
    simp_all only [neg_mul, neg_neg, add_left_eq_self, add_right_eq_self, not_true_eq_false,
      false_and]
  · by_cases h3 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4)
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l012 + h1
      simp_all
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l023
      have h5 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l013 - 1 * h4
      rw [h4, h5] at hcube
      have h6 : S.val (3 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
        linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h6
      simp_all

informal_statement: If a line satisfies the cubic permutation conditions, then it also satisfies the planar permutation conditions.
informal_proof:
First, we assume that a line \( L \) satisfies the `LineInCubicPerm_last_perm` condition, denoted as \( L \in \text{LineInCubicPerm}_{last} \). This condition involves some specific properties or permutations that \( L \) must fulfill within a cubic framework.

Given that \( L \) satisfies `LineInCubicPerm_last_perm`, we can infer that it inherently possesses the necessary properties that define `LineInPlanePerm_last_perm`. This is likely due to the fact that cubic permutations encompass a more general set of properties, some of which are also satisfied by lines within planar configurations. 

Therefore, \( L \) not only satisfies the cubic permutation conditions but also the specific planar permutation conditions required by `LineInPlanePerm_last_perm`. This logical progression confirms that any line adhering to the cubic permutation criteria must also conform to the planar permutation criteria. 

In conclusion, the `LineInCubicPerm_last_perm` condition is a more generalized form that inherently includes the `LineInPlanePerm_last_perm` condition. Hence, if a line meets the former, it must also meet the latter.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,

/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),

      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h

  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC

  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_cond {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ+1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInPlaneProp ((S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)), ((S.val (oddShiftFst 0)), (S.val oddShiftZero))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, f, hfg⟩ := span_basis S

  rw [P_P_P!_accCube' g f hfg] at h1
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
  · left
    linear_combination h1
  · cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
      linear_combination h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
      linear_combination h1

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_perm {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) : LineInPlaneCond S := by
  refine @Prop_three (2 * n.succ.succ + 1) LineInPlaneProp S (oddShiftSnd 0) (oddShiftFst 0)
    oddShiftZero ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_

  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact ne_of_beq_false rfl
  · exact fun M => lineInCubicPerm_last_cond (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC M)

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

lemma lineInCubicPerm_last_cond {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ+1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInPlaneProp ((S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)), ((S.val (oddShiftFst 0)), (S.val oddShiftZero))) := by
  obtain ⟨g, f, hfg⟩ := span_basis S
  have h1 := lineInCubicPerm_swap LIC 0 g f hfg
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube' g f hfg] at h1
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
  · left
    linear_combination h1
  · cases h1 <;> rename_i h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
      linear_combination h1
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
      linear_combination h1

    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by

  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :

    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

lemma P_P_P!_accCube' {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (f g : Fin n.succ.succ → ℚ) (hS : S.val = Pa f g) :
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P f) (P f) (basis!AsCharges 0) =
    (S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) *
    (2 * S.val oddShiftZero + S.val (oddShiftFst 0) + S.val (oddShiftSnd 0)) := by
  rw [P_P_P!_accCube f 0]
  rw [← Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g]
  rw [← hS]
  have ht : oddShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ.succ) = oddFst 1 := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [ht]
  rw [P_oddFst]
  have h1 := Pa_oddShiftShiftZero f g
  have h4 := Pa_oddShiftShiftSnd f g 0
  have h2 := Pa_oddShiftShiftFst f g 0
  rw [← hS] at h1 h2 h4
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.castSucc_zero] at h2
  have h5 : f 1 = S.val (oddShiftShiftFst 0) + S.val oddShiftShiftZero +
      S.val (oddShiftShiftSnd 0) := by
    linear_combination -(1 * h1) - 1 * h4 - 1 * h2
  rw [h5, oddShiftShiftSnd_eq_oddShiftSnd,
    show (oddShiftShiftFst (0 : Fin n.succ)) = oddShiftFst 0 from rfl,
    oddShiftShiftZero_eq_oddShiftZero]
  ring

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  intro j g f h
  let S' := (FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)) S
  have hSS' : ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n.succ + 1)).linSolRep
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j))) S = S' := rfl
  obtain ⟨g', f', hall⟩ := span_basis_swap! j hSS' g f h
  have h1 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self LIC) g f h
  have h2 := line_in_cubic_P_P_P! (lineInCubicPerm_self (lineInCubicPerm_permute LIC
    (pairSwap (oddShiftFst j) (oddShiftSnd j)))) g' f' hall.1
  rw [hall.2.1, hall.2.2] at h2
  rw [accCubeTriLinSymm.map_add₃, h1, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h2
  simpa using h2

rag.name: TriLinearSymm
rag.content:
/-- The structure of a symmetric trilinear function. -/
structure TriLinearSymm (V : Type) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℚ V] extends
    V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ where
  swap₁' : ∀ S T L, toFun S T L = toFun T S L
  swap₂' : ∀ S T L, toFun S T L = toFun S L T

rag.name: PureU1.FamilyPermutations
rag.content:
/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.swap₁
rag.content:
lemma swap₁ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f T S L :=
  f.swap₁' S T L

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.toLinear₁_apply
rag.content: lemma toLinear₁_apply (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f.toLinear₁ T L S := rfl

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.swap₂
rag.content:
lemma swap₂ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f S L T :=
  f.swap₂' S T L

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.swap₃
rag.content:
lemma swap₃ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f L T S := by
  rw [f.swap₁, f.swap₂, f.swap₁]

lemma map_smul₂ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S : V) (a : ℚ) (T L : V) :
    f S (a • T) L = a * f S T L := by

Firstly, we define the operation of swapping two elements within the permutation, which leads us to consider a transformed version of `S`, denoted as `S'`. By the reflexive property of equality, we establish that `S` itself satisfies the condition outlined in `hSS'`.

Next, we apply the inductive property `line_in_cubic_P_P_P!` to both the original and swapped versions of `S`, introducing fresh variables `g'`, `f'`, and `hall` to represent the updated functions and witnesses consistent with the symmetries imposed.

Subsequently, we recursively apply the lemma `lineInCubicPerm_permute` after swapping, ensuring that the updated functions `g'` and `f'` align with the congruence conditions defined by `hall`.

Finally, by substituting the rewritten form of the goal and simplifying the expression, we achieve the desired result, thereby confirming the symmetric property encapsulated by `accCubeTriLinSymm` equates to zero under the given conditions.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.PureU1.Odd.BasisLinear
/-!

# Line In Cubic Odd case

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubicPerm (M S)` for all permutations `M`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_permute {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols}
    (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) (M' : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group) :
    LineInCubicPerm ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M' S) :=
  fun M => hS (M * M')

lemma lineInCubicPerm_swap {S : (PureU1 (2 * n.succ + 1)).LinSols}
    (LIC : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    ∀ (j : Fin n.succ) (g f : Fin n.succ → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f),
      (S.val (oddShiftSnd j) - S.val (oddShiftFst j))
      * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (basis!AsCharges j) = 0 := by
  exact?

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C1_dependencies.name: PureU1.pairSwap
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The permutation which swaps i and j. -/
def pairSwap {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) : (FamilyPermutations n).group where
  toFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  invFun s :=
    if s = i then
        j
    else
      if s = j then
        i
      else
        s
  left_inv s := by
    aesop
  right_inv s := by
    aesop

    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro i
    ring)
  (by
    intro S L T
    simp only [PureU1Charges_numberCharges]
    apply Fintype.sum_congr
    intro i
    ring)

  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

C0_dependencies.name: PureU1.Odd.lineInCubic_expand
C0_dependencies.content:
/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

C0_dependencies.name: PureU1.Odd.line_in_cubic_P_P_P!
C0_dependencies.content:
lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),

  intro g f hS

open VectorLikeOddPlane

  within the planes. -/

These mappings ensure that any linearity or other preserved properties inherent in the permuted solutions are also mirrored in the original solutions. Since such mappings preserve the essential characteristics of the solution set, including both the line property and the set of solutions itself, it logically follows that the line property must be preserved in the original solution set \( S \).

/-!

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

We show that for a solution all its permutations satisfy this property,
then the charge must be zero.

The main reference for this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.04804.pdf
-/
namespace PureU1
namespace Odd

open BigOperators

variable {n : ℕ}
open VectorLikeOddPlane

/-- A property on `LinSols`, satisfied if every point on the line between the two planes
in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/
def LineInCubic (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),
  accCube (2 * n + 1) (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0

/-- The condition that a linear solution sits on a line between the two planes
  within the cubic expands into a on `accCubeTriLinSymm` applied to the points
  within the planes. -/
lemma lineInCubic_expand {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f) (a b : ℚ),
    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)
    + b * accCubeTriLinSymm (P! f) (P! f) (P g)) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS a b
  have h1 := h g f hS a b
  change accCubeTriLinSymm.toCubic (a • P g + b • P! f) = 0 at h1
  simp only [TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add] at h1
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic.map_smul,
    accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₁, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₂, accCubeTriLinSymm.map_smul₃] at h1
  erw [P_accCube, P!_accCube] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  ring

lemma line_in_cubic_P_P_P! {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (h : LineInCubic S) :
    ∀ (g : Fin n → ℚ) (f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = P g + P! f),
    accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f) = 0 := by
  intro g f hS
  linear_combination 2 / 3 * (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 1) -
      (lineInCubic_expand h g f hS 1 2) / 6

/-- A `LinSol` satisfies `lineInCubicPerm` if all its permutations satisfy `lineInCubic`. -/
def LineInCubicPerm (S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (M : (FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).group),
    LineInCubic ((FamilyPermutations (2 * n + 1)).linSolRep M S)

/-- If `lineInCubicPerm S`, then `lineInCubic S`. -/
lemma lineInCubicPerm_self {S : (PureU1 (2 * n + 1)).LinSols} (hS : LineInCubicPerm S) :
    LineInCubic S := hS 1

lemma Prop_three (P : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ → Prop) {S : (PureU1 n).LinSols}
    {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)

    P ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val a),
      ((((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val b),
      (((FamilyPermutations n).linSolRep f S).val c)))) : ∀ (i j k : Fin n)
      (_ : i ≠ j) (_ : j ≠ k) (_ : i ≠ k), P (S.val i, (S.val j, S.val k)) := by
  intro i j k hij hjk hik
  have h1 := h (permThree hij hjk hik hab hbc hac).symm
  rw [FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply, FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply,
    FamilyPermutations_anomalyFreeLinear_apply] at h1
  simp only [Equiv.invFun_as_coe, Equiv.symm_symm] at h1
  change P
    (S.val ((permThree hij hjk hik hab hbc hac).toFun a),
    S.val ((permThree hij hjk hik hab hbc hac).toFun b),
    S.val ((permThree hij hjk hik hab hbc hac).toFun c)) at h1

  exact h1

rag.name: mem_permsOfList_of_mem
rag.content:
theorem mem_permsOfList_of_mem {l : List α} {f : Perm α} (h : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → x ∈ l) :
    f ∈ permsOfList l := by
  induction l generalizing f with
  | nil =>
    -- Porting note: applied `not_mem_nil` because it is no longer true definitionally.
    simp only [not_mem_nil] at h
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 (Equiv.ext fun x => Decidable.byContradiction <| h x)
  | cons a l IH =>
  by_cases hfa : f a = a
  · refine mem_append_left _ (IH fun x hx => mem_of_ne_of_mem ?_ (h x hx))
    rintro rfl
    exact hx hfa
  have hfa' : f (f a) ≠ f a := mt (fun h => f.injective h) hfa
  have : ∀ x : α, (Equiv.swap a (f a) * f) x ≠ x → x ∈ l := by
    intro x hx
    have hxa : x ≠ a := by
      rintro rfl
      apply hx
      simp only [mul_apply, swap_apply_right]
    refine List.mem_of_ne_of_mem hxa (h x fun h => ?_)
    simp only [mul_apply, swap_apply_def, mul_apply, Ne, apply_eq_iff_eq] at hx
    split_ifs at hx with h_1
    exacts [hxa (h.symm.trans h_1), hx h]
  suffices f ∈ permsOfList l ∨ ∃ b ∈ l, ∃ g ∈ permsOfList l, Equiv.swap a b * g = f by
    simpa only [permsOfList, exists_prop, List.mem_map, mem_append, List.mem_flatMap]
  refine or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun _hfl => ⟨f a, ?_, Equiv.swap a (f a) * f, IH this, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_of_ne_of_mem hfa (h _ hfa')
  · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_def (swap a (f a)) (swap a (f a)), swap_swap, ← Perm.one_def, one_mul]

rag.name: TriLinearSymm
rag.content:
/-- The structure of a symmetric trilinear function. -/
structure TriLinearSymm (V : Type) [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℚ V] extends
    V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ where
  swap₁' : ∀ S T L, toFun S T L = toFun T S L
  swap₂' : ∀ S T L, toFun S T L = toFun S L T

lemma map_add₃ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L1 L2 : V) :
    f S T (L1 + L2) = f S T L1 + f S T L2 := by
  rw [f.swap₃, f.map_add₁, f.swap₃, f.swap₃ L2 T S]

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.toCubic_add
rag.content:
lemma toCubic_add {charges : Type} [AddCommMonoid charges] [Module ℚ charges]
    (τ : TriLinearSymm charges) (S T : charges) :
    τ.toCubic (S + T) = τ.toCubic S +
    τ.toCubic T + 3 * τ S S T + 3 * τ T T S := by
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic, toCubic_apply]
  rw [τ.map_add₁, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃]
  rw [τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₁ T S S, τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₂ T S T, τ.swap₁ S T T, τ.swap₂ T S T]
  ring

lemma swap₁ (f : TriLinearSymm V) (S T L : V) : f S T L = f T S L :=
  f.swap₁' S T L

informal_statement: If a line lies in the intersection of three cubic space configurations, then a specific symmetric expression involving points from these configurations equals zero.
informal_proof:
Consider a line that is common to three cubic space configurations. By definition, every point on this line satisfies the equations of all three cubic structures. 

Let’s denote three points on the cubic structures as \( P_1, P_2, P_3 \). Due to the line being an intersection, these points are collinear, and their symmetric combination, specifically \( \text{accCubeTriLinSymm}(P_1, P_2, P_3) \), must satisfy the condition of being invariant under the cubic space transformations.

Given the nature of cubic space and the symmetric property of the expression \( \text{accCubeTriLinSymm} \), the combination inherently balances the contributions of each cubic structure. The coefficients in the expression, such as \( \frac{2}{3} \) and \( \frac{1}{6} \), are chosen to enforce this balance, ensuring that the asymmetric components cancel out. As a result, the symmetric expression evaluates to zero, satisfying the equation \( \text{accCubeTriLinSymm}(P_1, P_2, P_3) = 0 \).

This conclusion is reached by leveraging the geometric condition of the line's shared location within the cubic configurations and the algebraic symmetry enforced by the coefficients, leading to the expression's cancellation.

rag.name: TriLinearSymm.mk₃
rag.content:
/-- The construction of a symmetric trilinear map from `smul` and `map_add` in the first factor,
and two swap. -/
@[simps!]
def mk₃ (f : V × V × V→ ℚ) (map_smul : ∀ a S T L, f (a • S, T, L) = a * f (S, T, L))
    (map_add : ∀ S1 S2 T L, f (S1 + S2, T, L) = f (S1, T, L) + f (S2, T, L))
    (swap₁ : ∀ S T L, f (S, T, L) = f (T, S, L))
    (swap₂ : ∀ S T L, f (S, T, L) = f (S, L, T)) : TriLinearSymm V where
  toFun := fun S => (BiLinearSymm.mk₂ (fun T => f (S, T))
    (by
      intro a T L
      simp only
      rw [swap₁, map_smul, swap₁])
    (by
      intro S1 S2 T
      simp only
      rw [swap₁, map_add, swap₁, swap₁ S2 S T])
    (by
      intro L T
      exact swap₂ S L T)).toLinearMap
  map_add' S1 S2 := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro T
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro S
    exact map_add S1 S2 T S
  map_smul' a S :=
    LinearMap.ext fun T => LinearMap.ext fun L => map_smul a S T L
  swap₁' := swap₁
  swap₂' := swap₂

lemma toCubic_add {charges : Type} [AddCommMonoid charges] [Module ℚ charges]
    (τ : TriLinearSymm charges) (S T : charges) :
    τ.toCubic (S + T) = τ.toCubic S +
    τ.toCubic T + 3 * τ S S T + 3 * τ T T S := by
  simp only [HomogeneousCubic, toCubic_apply]
  rw [τ.map_add₁, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₂, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃, τ.map_add₃]
  rw [τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₁ T S S, τ.swap₂ S T S, τ.swap₂ T S T, τ.swap₁ S T T, τ.swap₂ T S T]
  ring

/-- The homogenous cubic equation obtainable from a symmetric trilinear function. -/
@[simps!]
def toCubic {charges : Type} [AddCommMonoid charges] [Module ℚ charges]
    (τ : TriLinearSymm charges) : HomogeneousCubic charges where
  toFun S := τ S S S
  map_smul' a S := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [τ.map_smul₁, τ.map_smul₂, τ.map_smul₃]
    ring

/-- The permutations acting on the ACC system. -/
@[simp]
def FamilyPermutations (n : ℕ) : ACCSystemGroupAction (PureU1 n) where
  group := PermGroup n
  groupInst := inferInstance
  rep := permCharges
  linearInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberLinear] at i
    match i with
    | 0 => exact accGrav_invariant
  quadInvariant := by
    intro i
    simp only [PureU1_numberQuadratic] at i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  cubicInvariant := accCube_invariant

We say that a linear solution satisfies the `lineInCubic` property
if the line through that point and through the two different planes formed by the basis of
`LinSols` lies in the cubic.

then the charge must be zero.

in the basis through that point is in the cubic. -/

  ∀ (g f : Fin n → ℚ) (_ : S.val = Pa g f) (a b : ℚ),

    3 * a * b * (a * accCubeTriLinSymm (P g) (P g) (P! f)

rag.name: PureU1.LineInPlaneProp
rag.content:
/-- The proposition on three rationals to satisfy the `linInPlane` condition. -/
def LineInPlaneProp : ℚ × ℚ × ℚ → Prop := fun s =>
  s.1 = s.2.1 ∨ s.1 = - s.2.1 ∨ 2 * s.2.2 + s.1 + s.2.1 = 0

rag.name: PureU1.LineInPlaneCond
rag.content:
/-- The proposition on a `LinSol` to satisfy the `linInPlane` condition. -/
def LineInPlaneCond (S : (PureU1 n).LinSols) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i1 i2 i3 : Fin n) (_ : i1 ≠ i2) (_ : i2 ≠ i3) (_ : i1 ≠ i3),
  LineInPlaneProp (S.val i1, (S.val i2, S.val i3))

rag.name: PureU1.VectorLikeOddPlane.basis!_linear_independent
rag.content:
theorem basis!_linear_independent : LinearIndependent ℚ (@basis! n) := by
  apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr
  intro f h
  change P!' f = 0 at h
  have h1 : (P!' f).val = 0 :=
    (AddSemiconjBy.eq_zero_iff (ACCSystemLinear.LinSols.val 0)
    (congrFun (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (congrArg ACCSystemLinear.LinSols.val (id (Eq.symm h))))
    (ACCSystemLinear.LinSols.val 0))).mp rfl
  rw [P!'_val] at h1
  exact P!_zero f h1

PureU1.linesInPlane_constAbs_four
rag.content:
lemma linesInPlane_constAbs_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols)
    (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) : ConstAbs S.val := by
  intro i j
  by_cases hij : i ≠ j
  · exact linesInPlane_eq_sq_four hS i j hij
  · simp only [PureU1_numberCharges, ne_eq, Decidable.not_not] at hij
    rw [hij]

rag.name: PureU1.linesInPlane_four
rag.content:
lemma linesInPlane_four (S : (PureU1 4).Sols) (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) :
    ConstAbsProp (S.val (0 : Fin 4), S.val (1 : Fin 4)) := by
  simp only [ConstAbsProp, Fin.isValue]
  by_contra hn
  have hLin := pureU1_linear S.1.1
  have hcube := pureU1_cube S
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, PureU1_numberCharges] at hLin hcube
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hLin hcube
  rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at hn
  simp only [Fin.isValue, not_or] at hn
  have l012 := hS 0 1 2 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l013 := hS 0 1 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  have l023 := hS 0 2 3 (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl) (ne_of_beq_false rfl)
  simp_all [LineInPlaneProp]
  have h1 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
    linear_combination l012 / 2 + -1 * l013 / 2
  by_cases h2 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = S.val (2 : Fin 4)
  · simp_all
    have h3 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
      linear_combination l012 + 3 * h1
    rw [← h1, h3] at hcube
    have h4 : S.val (2 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
    simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h4
    simp_all only [neg_mul, neg_neg, add_left_eq_self, add_right_eq_self, not_true_eq_false,
      false_and]
  · by_cases h3 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4)
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = - S.val (2 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l012 + h1
      simp_all
    · simp_all
      have h4 : S.val (0 : Fin 4) = - 3 * S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l023
      have h5 : S.val (1 : Fin 4) = S.val (3 : Fin 4) := by
        linear_combination l013 - 1 * h4
      rw [h4, h5] at hcube
      have h6 : S.val (3 : Fin 4) ^ 3 = 0 := by
        linear_combination -1 * hcube / 24
      simp only [Fin.isValue, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, pow_eq_zero_iff] at h6
      simp_all

rag.name: PureU1.linesInPlane_constAbs_AF
rag.content:
theorem linesInPlane_constAbs_AF (S : (PureU1 (n.succ.succ.succ.succ)).Sols)
    (hS : LineInPlaneCond S.1.1) : ConstAbs S.val := by
  induction n
  · exact linesInPlane_constAbs_four S hS
  · exact linesInPlane_constAbs hS

informal_statement: A property of `LinSols` is defined such that for any planes in the basis defined by `Fin n -> ℚ`, every line between them lies entirely within the cubic. This property ensures that any linear combination of points from these planes, scaled by rational coefficients, satisfies the cubic constraint.
informal_proof: By the nature of the definition of `LineInCubic`, which verifies that every point on the line formed by linearly combining points from the planes lies within the cubic, it is inherently satisfied by any planes in the basis due to the linear algebraic structure imposed. Thus, the property `LineInCubic` ensures that all such lines are contained within the cubic space, fulfilling the requirement that every linear combination of points from the planes conforms to the cubic equation.
